<strong>Model Context Protocol</strong>: Model Context Protocol is an open standard that lets an assistant discover and call external tools and data. Client-server model: MCP host (VS Code, SSMS, Visual Studio, Claude…) → MCP client (connector inside the host) → MCP server (exposes tools and, optionally, resources and prompts). Transports: stdio (local process) and streamable HTTP (remote; sse as a fallback). Key messages: tools/list and tools/call.

Limita la exposición de datos sensibles: Limits the exposure of sensitive data by obfuscating the query result for users without UNMASK. The stored data does not change and the app is not modified.
Máscara total por tipo: strings <code>XX: Full mask by type: strings XXXX (fewer X if the field length is < 4); numeric 0; date/time 1900-01-01 00:00:00.0000000; binary one ASCII 0 byte (the Azure SQL docs say “empty value” for binary/varbinary/image). In Azure SQL: XML <masked />; sql_variant uses the default value of its type.

Número aleatorio en el rango, distinto e: Random number within the range, different for each query; numeric types only. If start = end, it is constant.
Custom string: muestra <em>prefix</em> c: Custom string: shows prefix characters at the start, the padding and suffix at the end. If the value is short, part of the prefix/suffix is hidden. partial(1,"XXXXXXX",0): 555.123.1234 → 5XXXXXXX.
Enmascara año, mes, día, hora, minuto o: Masks the year, month, day, hour, minute or second in date, datetime, datetime2, datetimeoffset, smalldatetime, time. SQL Server 2022+, Azure SQL, Fabric SQL DB.
Solo Azure SQL DB y solo T-SQL. <code>ch: Azure SQL DB only and T-SQL only. char/nchar/varchar/nvarchar and LOB up to 2 MB; pattern ≤ 8,000 bytes; start = 1, occurrence = 0 (all), fixed 'c' flags. Anything that does not match the pattern stays unmasked. Do not use in production.
Ver datos sin máscara. Granular en BD, e: View unmasked data. Granular at DB, schema, table or column level (SQL Server 2022+, Azure SQL, Fabric SQL DB). Always needs SELECT; on its own it does not even reveal metadata.
Agregar, cambiar o quitar máscaras (rol: Add, change or remove masks (security officer role).
Incluye <code>ALTER ANY MASK</code> y <c: Includes ALTER ANY MASK and UNMASK: db_owner and sysadmin see everything. In Azure SQL, also the server admin and Entra admin.
Solo <code>CREATE TABLE</code> y <code>A: Only CREATE TABLE and ALTER on the schema.
Roles de Azure: SQL Security Manager, SQ: Azure roles: SQL Security Manager, SQL DB Contributor, SQL Server Contributor (action Microsoft.Sql/servers/databases/dataMaskingPolicies/*). MI and Fabric SQL DB: T-SQL only.
No se define máscara en columnas Always: A mask cannot be defined on Always Encrypted columns, FILESTREAM, COLUMN_SET/sparse in the column set, or PolyBase external tables; nor on a computed column (but a computed column that depends on a masked column returns the masked value). A masked column cannot be the key of a full-text index.
Agregar una máscara es un <em>schema cha: Adding a mask is a schema change: it fails if there are dependencies (computed columns, indexes): remove the dependency, mask, and re-create it.
Toda expresión que proyecta una columna: Any expression that projects a masked column is always masked with default(), regardless of the original function.

Controla el acceso a filas según el cont: Controls access to rows based on the user context. Two parts: a predicate (inline table-valued function that returns a row if there is access) and a security policy that binds it to a table.
La app, tras autenticar al usuario:: The app, after authenticating the user:
<strong>Fail-open:</strong> el <code>ELS: Fail-open: the ELSE @SalesRegion in the exercise lets any unlisted user see all regions. In production, make the predicate fail-closed (user→region mapping table or SESSION_CONTEXT; no match, no rows).
Filtra en silencio los datos de lectura:: Silently filters data on read: affects SELECT, UPDATE and DELETE (no error; returns an empty set). INSERT is still allowed.
Error si la fila insertada viola el pred: Error if the inserted row violates the predicate (prevents inserting for another tenant).
Error si el UPDATE deja la fila en un va: Error if the UPDATE leaves the row with a value that violates the predicate.
Error si la fila <em>actual</em> ya viol: Error if the current row already violates the predicate.
Bloquea el <code>DELETE</code> de filas: Blocks DELETE of rows that violate the predicate.
Aplica a todas las operaciones de escrit: Applies to all write operations. In sys.security_predicates.operation: NULL = all, 1 AFTER INSERT, 2 AFTER UPDATE, 3 BEFORE UPDATE, 4 BEFORE DELETE.
Como máximo uno por operación DML y tabl: At most one per DML operation and table. Several policies only if they do not overlap; on the same operation, only one enabled at a time.
La policy usa <code>SCHEMABINDING = ON</: The policy uses SCHEMABINDING = ON by default: functions must be created WITH SCHEMABINDING, neither the function nor the referenced columns can be altered, and users do not need permissions on the predicate's tables/functions. With OFF they do need them (SELECT/EXECUTE). ALTER SECURITY POLICY does not change SCHEMABINDING: DROP and CREATE.
Docs inconsistentes: el texto del argume: Inconsistent docs: the argument text of CREATE SECURITY POLICY says that without STATE the policy is enabled, but its example A leaves it disabled and the RLS article says “The STATE must be set to ON to enable the policy”. Always write STATE = ON.
Crear/alterar/borrar policy: <code>ALTER: Create/alter/drop a policy: ALTER ANY SECURITY POLICY (+ ALTER on the schema to create/drop). For each predicate: SELECT and REFERENCES on the function, REFERENCES on the table and on each column used as an argument. The policy manager does not need SELECT on the table.
A <strong>todos</strong>, incluidos dbo,: To everyone, including dbo, db_owner and the table owner. If sysadmin/db_owner must see everything, the predicate must allow it.
<code>USER_NAME()</code>, <code>DATABASE: USER_NAME(), DATABASE_PRINCIPAL_ID(), IS_MEMBER() for DB users; SESSION_CONTEXT() with a middle-tier app. sp_set_session_context: key ≤ 128 bytes, sql_variant value ≤ 8,000 bytes, total context ≤ 1 MB; @read_only = 1 prevents changing the value until the connection is closed (returned to the pool).
Se divide en BEFORE y AFTER: no puedes b: It is split into BEFORE and AFTER: you cannot block “raising the salary” by comparing old and new; for that, use a trigger with INSERTED/DELETED. AFTER UPDATE is not evaluated if the predicate columns do not change. BULK INSERT honors AFTER INSERT.
FILESTREAM ✗; indexed views sobre tablas: FILESTREAM ✗; indexed views on tables with a policy ✗; memory-optimized: function WITH NATIVE_COMPILATION + SCHEMABINDING; partitioned views: no BLOCK (FILTER is allowed); temporal: the policy is not replicated to the history table (add the predicate to both); CDC/change tracking can leak rows or PKs; DBCC SHOW_STATISTICS only for owner, sysadmin, db_owner, db_ddladmin; columnstore compatible (may lose batch mode).
Fabric Data Warehouse / SQL analytics en: Fabric Data Warehouse / SQL analytics endpoint and Synapse: FILTER only. The RLS article says “Microsoft Fabric and Azure Synapse Analytics support filter predicates only” and its Applies to includes SQL database in Fabric (same engine as Azure SQL DB): Verify whether the latter accepts BLOCK.
Esquema separado (<code>Security</code>): Separate schema (Security) for functions and policies; avoid type conversions, recursion and excessive joins (performance).
No dependas de <code>SET</code> options: Do not depend on SET options (DATEFORMAT, LANGUAGE, DATEFIRST, ANSI_WARNINGS, ARITHABORT, CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL): use CONVERT with an explicit style.
Side-channel: consultas como <code>SELEC: Side-channel: queries such as SELECT 1/(Salary-100000) … leak information through errors; a malicious policy manager can exfiltrate data with a custom TVF: audit changes to policies and functions.
<code>READ UNCOMMITTED</code> puede ver: READ UNCOMMITTED can see transient values because BLOCK predicates are evaluated after the DML.
<strong>Diagnóstico:</strong> si un resu: Diagnostics: if a result looks odd, disable the policy (STATE = OFF) and compare. Documented alternative to AFTER UPDATE with a single-user app: DENY UPDATE on the predicate column.
